facts.fact: The Adwave guide 'Connected TV vs Linear TV for Performance Marketers' was published on 2026-07-17.
Adwave states that analyzing a website is free and that advertisers can see their plan before spending.
facts.quote: Free to analyze. See your plan before you spend.

facts.fact: According to the page, Linear TV is scheduled programming on broadcast or cable where advertisers buy dayparts and programs, while Connected TV is video delivered over the internet to a television screen, usually inside streaming apps.
facts.quote: Linear TV is scheduled programming on broadcast or cable. You buy dayparts and programs. Connected TV is video delivered over the internet to a television screen, usually inside streaming apps.

facts.fact: Adwave says its product covers streaming TV alongside Mobile web, Mobile apps, Google, Meta, and Reddit, and that TikTok runs when the advertiser turns it on in Customize and connects a TikTok account.
facts.quote: Adwave focuses on streaming TV alongside Mobile web, Mobile apps, Google, Meta, and Reddit in the same product. TikTok runs when you turn it on in Customize and connect your TikTok account.

facts.fact: The page states that linear TV buys often force flighting and minimums, while connected TV lets advertisers start smaller and stay always-on, though no dollar minimums are given.
facts.quote: Linear often forces flighting and minimums that fight local seasonality.
